name: Alene
title: Circle of the Stars Druid
role: The party's controller and only healer. She opens with a concentration spell such as Spike Growth, Hold Person, Moonbeam or Call Lightning, then spends her bonus action in a Starry Form: Archer for radiant shots that pile on Reverberation and Radiating Orb, or Chalice to heal as she casts healing spells. Dragon suits fights where she's being hit: concentration save rolls of 9 or lower count as 10. Each form costs a Wild Shape charge, so pick one per fight until level 10, when she can swap free once a turn. On blighted ground in the Shadow-Cursed Lands, Moonbeam loses Concentration.

gear.note: +1 spell DC and spell attack; Melf's Acid Arrow once a day.
Clothing: +1 spell DC. Its +1 AC and saves need Lightning Charges, which nothing on this page gives you.
You regain 1d6 HP whenever you heal someone else. A reward from Zevlor for helping the refugees: accept the money, and it's in the Patched-Together Sack.

Medium armour: your radiant damage sets off a shockwave that adds Radiating Orb. With Boots of Stormy Clamour, that Radiating Orb should add Reverberation too (check in game). Its shockwave doesn't trigger from Moonbeam (wiki).

Medium armour, AC 13 + DEX (max 2). Undead that hit you take 1d6 radiant, but beasts that hit you deal 1d6 more radiant, so swap it out against beasts. On a headless skeleton near the owlbear nest in Act 1.
Radiant, thunder and lightning damage add Reverberation (−1 to STR, DEX and CON saves per turn). Not Moonbeam, and an area spell only affects its first target.

Inflicting a condition also adds 2 turns of Reverberation, once per action and on the first target only. Radiating Orb from Luminous Armour, Luminous Gloves or Coruscation Ring is listed as a condition on the wiki, so it should set the boots off on radiant hits, though an older wiki note says Coruscation Ring's doesn't: check in game.
Light armour with Advantage on CON saves.
8 temporary HP when you first cast a concentration spell; free recasts of Moonbeam or Call Lightning don't count.
+1 AC and saves.
Heals you give others grant resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage for 2 turns (a bug widens it beyond weapons). Healing yourself doesn't count.
Your heals give +1d4 to attacks and saves for 2 turns, even on a target at full health and on everyone a Mass Healing Word reaches.
+1 spell DC and +1 initiative.
+1 spell DC and spell attack, Advantage on DEX saves. Ketheric only drops it at the very end of Act 2, so it's an Act 3 pick.

+1 spell DC and spell attack, +2 AC, and 1d6 HP back whenever you pass a save against a spell. In a Globe of Invulnerability in Act 3: See Invisibility reveals the lever, then each character gets one Arcana DC 20 try. Nobody in the party has that spell yet.
+2 HP on every heal you give another creature, so Mass Healing Word and Chalice heals add up. Sold by Omeluum in the Underdark after Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite.
Your heals also give 3 temporary HP. Sold by Grat in the Goblin Camp.
Healing Word and Mass Healing Word once per long rest each, without spending your slots. These free casts don't refresh Chalice Healing. Sold by Derryth Bonecloak in the Underdark.
Ray of Fear and Wounding Ray as 3rd-level spells, once per long rest each. Worn by the Spectator at the Underdark's Petrified Battlefield.
+2 AC and +1 to every save, concentration included. Sold by Dammon at the Emerald Grove. Your staff works one-handed beside it.

+1 initiative from the ranged slot, so your opening control spell goes first more often. Sold by Roah Moonglow in the Shattered Sanctum. Druids can't use shortbows well, but the initiative still counts.
Restore one spell slot of any level, once per long rest. A swap-in: put it on to use it (a bonus action), then switch back.

Your radiant damage, except Moonbeam, adds 2 turns of Radiating Orb (−1 to the target's attack rolls per turn, and it loses 2 turns each time the target attacks). With Boots of Stormy Clamour, that Radiating Orb should add Reverberation too (check in game).
Spell damage adds Radiating Orb. The description says you must be lit, but a bug makes it work at any light level.
+1 AC and saves. Pass it to Zetharis once you have Cloak of the Weave.
+2 spell DC and spell attack.

+2 spell DC. Taking it straight from the offering chest curses you: falling unconscious kills you until it's removed. Drag it to the floor first, or smash the chest, and pick it up from there to avoid the curse. Curing the curse can summon an enemy.
+1 spell DC and spell attack, and your next spell is free once a day: toggle it on just before a levelled spell, as a cantrip or scroll uses it up.

+1 spell DC and spell attack; you heal 1d4 when enemies fail your saves. It's destroyed if Astarion becomes a Vampire Ascendant, if his ritual is interrupted, or if you leave the spawn behind after the fight with Cazador. Don't kill a spawn during the dialogue afterwards.
Light armour: +1 spell DC, Advantage on CON saves to hold concentration, Plant Growth each short rest, and 1d4 HP each turn you start in it.
While concentrating, add your WIS modifier to every save and +1 AC. Needs a Persuasion check to open Ferg Drogher's special stock.
+1 spell DC and spell attack.
+1 spell DC; Command once a day.
+1 spell DC for any caster.
One more Wild Shape charge: one more Starry Form a day.
Ranged slot: +3 initiative. Druids aren't proficient with longbows, so its chance of Faerie Fire on a hit is a bonus, not a plan.
Starry Form counts as Wild Shape: 22 temporary HP each time you take it, +4 AC (+2 doubled by a bug) and Advantage on saves against spells. Swapping constellations drops the temporary HP.
+1 spell DC and spell attack. Its Absorb Elements is bugged (per the wiki).

loadouts.label: Act 1
loadouts.intro: Good picks per slot. Mix to taste: Spell DC, Radiant debuffs, or Concentration to hold your spells.

loadouts.label: Act 2
loadouts.intro: The radiant debuff kit comes together here, alongside the first +1 DC pieces.

loadouts.label: Act 3
loadouts.intro: The spell DC capstones arrive. Stacking the DC pieces reaches DC 27, though bugs keep Insect Plague's later ticks and Wall of Fire's end-of-turn damage from using it.
